title: data for roles.override
description: CoS-only: allow Sonnet for one task code until an expiry, with a reason. The board journals the computed expiry, so replay never reads the clock. clear=true removes the entry. If the server has no CoS identity on the token, data.lane must spell "CoS".

hours.description: How long the allowance lasts; default 24.

clear.description: Remove the task's override instead of setting one.

lane.description: The calling lane when the token carries none: must be "CoS".
